messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "inform doctor when starting or stopping heart or blood pressure medication"
set: ["inform doctor when starting or stopping heart or blood pressure medication", "inform doctor when starting or stopping seizure medication", "inform doctor when starting or stopping antifungal medication", "inform doctor when starting or stopping antibiotic", "especially heart or blood pressure medication", "inform doctor when starting or stopping medicine to treat HIV or hepatitis C", "inform doctor or pharmacist if taking other heart or blood pressure medications", "monitor for blood pressure changes when first starting", "tell doctor about all other heart or blood pressure medications", "check blood sugar more often when starting, changing, or stopping", "always talk to your doctor before stopping or switching medication", "monitor for blood pressure changes when starting again after a break", "tell doctor if have or had stroke or high blood pressure", "inform doctor if pregnant or breastfeeding", "monitor for dizziness or fainting when first starting", "avoid sudden cessation of alcohol consumption when starting medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
